topic: Customer traffic decline in S03, S04, S05
known: A sudden, broad loss of receipts from mid-July 2025, measured against matched control stores.
unknown: Why customers stopped visiting: no internal lever (price, promotions, availability, range, returns) explains it.
why_it_matters: Largest single component of the decline.
data_required: Footfall counters, competitor openings and promotions near the three stores, road / access works, local events, store operating logs (hours, closures, refits)

known: Full-week stock-outs rose, concentrated on Voltix SKUs; opening stock fell while weekly receipts per SKU did not.
unknown: Whether the supplier under-delivered or Brightwater ordered or replenished too little.
why_it_matters: The only mechanism with root-cause evidence; responsibility decides who acts.
data_required: Purchase orders, supplier confirmations and ASNs, delivery lead times and fill rates, Brightwater's own ordering parameters (min / max, safety stock) for these SKUs

known: Recorded 'Faulty' refunds rose, concentrated in a few stores and in sales from September 2025 onward.
unknown: Whether products are genuinely defective or stores record returns differently.
why_it_matters: A quality problem and a process problem need different owners.
data_required: QA inspection results, batch / lot or serial numbers, supplier defect and RMA reports, warranty claims, store returns-handling audits, and the distribution centre / delivery route serving these stores

known: Discount rate and promotion frequency rose sharply; the category fell relative to other categories.
unknown: Whether the promotions caused the decline: the four counterfactual methods disagree in sign.
why_it_matters: The commercial effect of the promotion programme is uncertain in both direction and size.
data_required: Promotion calendar with objectives, planned vs actual depth, a controlled test (holdout stores) or at least SKU-level price elasticities

known: Outside the cluster, new SKUs more than replaced delisted ones; continuing SKUs sold less per ranged week.
unknown: Whether shoppers switched to new models, or partial-week stock-outs and substitution explain it.
why_it_matters: Most of the unattributed residual sits here.
data_required: Range plan and delisting dates, customer-level purchase history (switching between models)
